title: The Term a Drug Coverage Request Earns on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan
content:
The term a drug coverage request earns on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is read from the kind of request the decision disposes of and from whether the prescriber's supporting statement stands received on it.

| The latest request standing on the coverage determination record | The prescriber's supporting statement on it | The term the request earns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| An expedited coverage determination | stands received | 90 days |
| A standard coverage determination | stands received | 365 days |
| An expedited coverage determination | not received | 180 days |
| A standard coverage determination | not received | 180 days |
| Any other kind of request | received or not | 180 days |

An expedited coverage determination with the statement in hand earns the plan's expedited term of 90 days, because an expedited decision rests on the evidence that could be gathered in the time allowed. A standard coverage determination with the statement in hand earns the plan's maintenance term of 365 days. Where the statement does not stand received, neither of those is reached and the request earns the plan's ordinary term of 180 days.

## Both parts of each condition

Each of the first two rows is compound: the kind of request and the standing of the prescriber's statement must both hold. A request that is expedited but carries no statement earns 180 days, not 90; a standard request that carries no statement earns 180 days, not 365.
